The '''Cegul system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cegul [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-20.<ref name="TEA" />
